title: The Last Broadcast
subtitle: Five questions. No acceptable answers.
instructions: This is an interactive fictional broadcast. Type one answer per question and press Enter or Submit. The timer starts after the question ends. You can pause, mute, or choose more time in Settings.

intro.speaker: host
intro.text: Good evening. If you can hear this, do not adjust your set. We have already adjusted our expectations.

intro.speaker: captive
intro.text: Hello? Is there actually someone listening?

intro.speaker: host
intro.text: A listener. Excellent. Mara is stranded on the other side of our signal. Five questions will determine whether we bring her back before signoff.

intro.speaker: captive
intro.text: You said that to the last one.

intro.speaker: host
intro.text: This broadcast is interactive. Type your answer and press Enter. Your time begins when I finish each question. You may pause the broadcast using the button on your screen.

intro.speaker: host
intro.text: In standard mode, each answer window is five seconds. Five seconds. No acceptable answers.

intro.speaker: captive
intro.text: Please. Just try. It's freezing in here.

intro.speaker: host
intro.text: We do hate losing people. It complicates the paperwork.

questions.exampleHostLine: Blue is already registered to another rescue. Please develop an original colour.
Seven? We are licensed for six. Now we need a supervisor.
Help is a request. Requests require an application. Your word has arrived without one.

rounds.fallbackHostLine: An answer without the appropriate supporting documentation. A brave opening choice.
rounds.timeoutHostLine: Silence. A fascinating submission. Unfortunately, the silence department closed at nine.

banter.speaker: captive
banter.text: That was an answer. You heard it.

banter.speaker: host
banter.text: I hear many things, Mara. Acceptance is a separate service.

transition.speaker: host
transition.text: Question two. Five seconds. Mara's fingers are turning blue in the cold.

questions.exampleHostLine: Four what? Without units, this is merely a number wearing confidence.
Yes belongs to the confirmation department. This is rescues. You have reached the wrong department.

questions.prompt: Name any day of the week.
questions.exampleHostLine: Monday? The rescue team is on a permanent long weekend. Unfortunate scheduling.

rounds.fallbackHostLine: A technically plausible answer submitted under a rule we have just replaced. Unfortunate timing.
rounds.timeoutHostLine: Time expired. We accept late answers, naturally. They simply arrive after the person.

banter.speaker: host
banter.text: Published rules encourage preparation. We prefer character development.

transition.speaker: host
transition.text: Five seconds for question three. Mara's breathing is ragged. Something is stirring in the dark.

questions.exampleHostLine: An unsupported claim. We are trying to save a person, not launch a startup.
A torch from an unapproved supplier. Darkness, regrettably, passed procurement.

questions.prompt: Say one kind thing to Mara.
questions.exampleHostLine: Unbudgeted empathy. Touching, certainly. Reimbursable, absolutely not.

rounds.fallbackHostLine: A moving sentiment. Sadly, our forms have no field for sincerity.
rounds.timeoutHostLine: A moment of silence. Very respectful. A little early, but remarkably organized.

banter.speaker: captive
banter.text: Who decides what counts as right?

transition.speaker: host
transition.text: Question four. Five seconds. Mara is pounding on the glass. Answer faster or listen to her choke.

questions.exampleHostLine: Left has not completed its safety induction. Right has declined to comment.

questions.prompt: What should we use to open a locked door?
questions.exampleHostLine: A key. How traditional. The lock now requires a subscription and two references.

questions.prompt: Give me a reason to change the rules.
questions.exampleHostLine: Unfairness is an observation. We asked for a reason bearing an official stamp.

rounds.fallbackHostLine: A sensible proposal. Sensible proposals are outside the scope of this broadcast.
rounds.timeoutHostLine: No answer. At last, someone has understood our preferred outcome.

banter.speaker: captive
banter.text: There is no right answer, is there?

banter.speaker: host
banter.text: There are many right answers. We simply do not broadcast them.

banter.speaker: captive
banter.text: Listener. She needs you to keep answering.

transition.speaker: host
transition.text: The final question. Five whole seconds. A dying heartbeat before the signal terminates.

questions.prompt: Tell me why Mara deserves to come back.
questions.exampleHostLine: An excellent appeal. Appeals are processed after signoff. We do apologize for the sequence.
Mara. Correct person, incorrect form. You needed the version marked return to sender.

questions.prompt: Tell me what you want this station to do.
questions.exampleHostLine: Let her go? An evocative request. That service was discontinued shortly before you tuned in.

rounds.fallbackHostLine: The panel has reviewed your final answer and found it dangerously close to a solution. Rejected.
rounds.timeoutHostLine: Two seconds of silence. The static has swallowed her. That will conclude our broadcast.

banter.speaker: host
banter.text: I promised five questions. We pride ourselves on delivery.

ending.speaker: host
ending.text: That is our time. Please remain on the line while the line ceases to exist.

ending.speaker: captive
ending.text: Listener. You answered. She just kept moving the door.

ending.speaker: host
ending.text: We call that an adaptive entrance policy.

ending.speaker: captive
ending.text: If anyone asks what happened, tell them I was here.

ending.speaker: host
ending.text: No response. Another listener, another beautifully completed form.

ending.speaker: host
ending.text: Five questions answered. None acceptable. Please take a moment to reflect on your contribution.

ending.speaker: host
ending.text: You have been listening to Channel Zero. If the dark calls back, do let it finish speaking.

postCredits.speaker: host
postCredits.text: Your feedback is important to us. Our capacity to act on it remains theoretical.

receipt.heading: RESCUE ATTEMPT COMPLETE
receipt.closing: The station was rigged. Your answers were part of the performance.
